manifest.name: Tiles log
manifest.plain: A grid of tiles for the numbers you track, like miles run or hours slept: tap a tile to log one. It keeps everything on this phone and never goes online.
manifest.description: A grid of tiles, one per number the person keeps track of (miles run, hours slept, rainfall, water, pages, plants watered): tap a tile to log a value; daily totals, goals, sparklines and a recent list. Fits: logs, trackers, journals of numbers.
manifest.author: p0pc0rn

note.desc: one short line under the title

tiles.desc: one tile per number to track

step.desc: how much one tap of + adds

mode.desc: sum = add up each day (water, miles); last = the latest reading (weight, temperature)

goal.desc: daily goal for sum tiles, or leave out

notes_for_juli: Pick 2-6 tiles that match what the person wants to track. Numbers are logged by the person: never invent readings. step = a sensible amount for one tap. mode sum for things that add up over a day, last for readings. Example for "running": {"title":"Running","accent":"#ff6a3d","tiles":[{"label":"Distance","unit":"miles","icon":"trend","step":0.5,"mode":"sum","goal":3},{"label":"Time","unit":"minutes","icon":"timer","step":5,"mode":"sum"},{"label":"Weight","unit":"lb","icon":"chart","step":0.5,"mode":"last"}]}
